name: Mercury Biopharmaceutical Corporation
summary: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Mercury Biopharmaceutical Corporation is dedicated to creating innovative pharmaceutical solutions for medical conditions currently lacking adequate treatment options. A cornerstone of their strategy is the proprietary StackDose platform, an advanced drug development system designed to formulate novel medication delivery methods. This platform facilitates precisely timed drug release, targeted absorption at specific locations within the body, and flexible dosage modifications. The primary objective of StackDose is to significantly boost the bioavailability of active pharmaceutical ingredients, leading to a reduction in required drug dosages and fewer adverse effects. Their development pipeline currently addresses a variety of ailments, such as erectile dysfunction, pulmonary hypertension, sleep disturbances, benign prostatic hyperplasia, angina, migraines, hypertension, and pain management.
